facts.summary: Discontinued enrollment and development after dose-limiting hand-foot skin reactions · Phase 1/2 · THE-630 in GIST · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Theseus Pharmaceuticals to Discontinue Enrollment in Phase 1/2 Study and Terminate Development of THE-630 in Patients with GIST
evidence.safety: Both the grade 3 HFSR and the grade 2 HFSR necessitating ≥7 days dose interruption were determined to be DLTs according to the study protocol.
evidence.program_discontinued: the Company has made the decision to terminate the development of THE-630 in GIST.
